status: Pre-implementation resource policy for the remaining readers; this file is not a claim that these limits are enforced yet
source: tests/evidence/linux/census.json and the pinned baseline fixture/oracle captures

headroom.input_bytes: 4.70 times the largest measured Linux fixture
headroom.emitted_bytes: 5.83 times the measured verbose/form-bearing info capture; dump output is streamed, never accumulated to this size
headroom.work_units: Provisional charged-operation budget, not a measured timing claim. Count byte reads, table/reference walks and output work; measure actual complete-corpus maxima before finalizing and retain at least fourfold observed headroom.
headroom.logical_allocation_bytes: Provisional explicit allocation-accounting budget, including geometric list growth and output buffers. Measure before finalizing; do not infer allocator bytes from DIE counts alone.
headroom.line_rows: 8.14 times the census-derived maximum (special opcodes + copy + end_sequence); independently confirm using the implemented reader before finalizing

requirements: No cap may exclude a recorded fixture
Unknown formats and encodings are distinct from resource exhaustion
Charge repeated scans and reference traversal, not merely input length
Use flattened DIE and attribute storage to avoid per-reference deep copies
Stream rendered output through bounded buffers and retire per-row temporary allocations
Native and checked tests exercise low caller-supplied limits and overflow boundaries
Full fixture matrices measure the implemented counters before final gauntlets
